patterns.note: Full-bleed product imagery and video are used extensively as background elements for text overlays and section introductions, creating an immersive visual experience.
Oversized, partially obscured typographic elements serve as dramatic section titles or visual anchors, often overlapping other content and acting as a primary design feature.
Large product model names (e.g., 'R1C', 'R2') animate into view with a horizontal slide or fade-in effect as the user scrolls, often appearing partially off-screen to create a dynamic reveal.
Content sections and individual blocks reveal with a subtle fade-up or slide-up animation as they enter the viewport, enhancing engagement and guiding the user's eye.
A minimalist color palette of white, light grey, and black is consistently used for backgrounds and text, with a single bright yellow/orange accent color reserved for calls to action.

technique_notes: The site employs scroll-triggered animations, likely using a library like GSAP ScrollTrigger, to reveal large typographic elements and content sections. These elements appear to slide or fade into their final positions as they enter the viewport, creating a dynamic and engaging reveal effect.

Hero sections feature full-bleed video or high-quality imagery with text overlays, where the background media exhibits subtle parallax or movement as the user scrolls, adding depth and visual interest.
The primary navigation bar remains fixed at the top of the viewport, maintaining visibility across scroll depths without significant visual transformation, ensuring consistent access to navigation.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extremely oversized, bold display headings (up to ~8x body text) with smaller, legible sans-serif body text and uppercase labels for product details.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners are dominant, with very subtle rounding on buttons and image containers, maintaining a clean and modern aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: Very airy, especially in hero sections and around large typographic elements, creating a sense of luxury and focus. Content grids maintain a balanced, consistent spacing.

standout: The most distinctive aspect is the bold and dramatic use of oversized, partially obscured typography as a primary visual element, often animating into view. This, combined with full-bleed, high-quality product imagery and subtle scroll-triggered reveals, creates a highly cinematic and luxurious user experience that feels more like an interactive magazine than a typical product website.
